title: Docs cross-linking and copy-edit pass across the factory corpus
summary: A repository-wide editorial pass over the documentation corpus, plus two comment-only edits in the Rust crate. The substantive change is navigational: bare references to sibling decision records ("decision 0003", "decision 0005") become relative Markdown links, and several documents gain links to the product decision and vision documents they depend on. Alongside that, prose is tightened throughout — quoted phrases lose their scare quotes, section headings gain colons or descriptive names, and a few tables are restructured (SkillEvaluator's three tiers, the security-phase table). No runtime behaviour changes: the only code touched is two doc comments in `crates/osf/src/hook.rs` and two in `crates/osf/tests/skill_lint.rs`, which drop a stale "Change N:" prefix.

flows.title: A reader follows a decision reference
